cases.en: Investigate a technical topic with several researchers, reconcile sources, review a draft and deliver a cited report.
cases.zh: 把一个技术课题交给研究团队，分头调查、核对来源、审稿，最后交付有引用的报告。

cases.en: Coordinate specialists to produce system architecture, deployment and security designs with explicit handoffs.
cases.zh: 请一个完整专家团队协作，产出系统架构、部署和安全设计，并明确各阶段交接。

cases.en: Our API slows during bursts. Design a realistic load experiment, identify the bottleneck and validate the optimization.
cases.zh: API在突发流量时变慢，请设计贴近实际的压测，定位瓶颈并验证优化前后效果。

cases.en: Turn business requirements into a structured test design covering boundaries, exceptions and traceability.
cases.zh: 把业务需求转为结构化测试设计，覆盖边界、异常，并能追溯到原需求。

cases.en: Deliver a coding feature through focused parallel implementers, test-first steps, separate specification and quality reviews, and final integration.
cases.zh: 把编码功能交给多个独立执行者并行实现，先建失败测试，分别做规格与质量评审，再集成验收。

cases.en: Polish and translate a machine learning paper into English while preserving equations and citations.
cases.zh: 把机器学习论文翻译润色成英文，保留公式与引用，检查术语表达。

cases.en: Verify the login flow of a local web app in a browser and capture screenshots and console errors.
cases.zh: 在浏览器里验证本地网页应用的登录流程，保留截图和控制台报错。

cases.en: Extract text and tabular data from a PDF and combine its pages into a new document.
cases.zh: 从PDF提取文字和表格，再把指定页面合并成一份新文档。

cases.en: Create an Excel workbook with editable formulas, consistent formatting and recalculated results.
cases.zh: 制作Excel工作簿，保留可编辑公式、统一格式并重新计算结果。

cases.en: Check whether a travel itinerary is affordable using transportation, accommodation and meal costs, and suggest cost-saving alternatives.
cases.zh: 按交通、住宿和餐饮费用核算旅行行程预算，判断是否超支并给出省钱替代方案。

cases.en: Find current documentation and code examples for a specific version of a programming library.
cases.zh: 查询某个编程库指定版本的最新文档与代码示例，避免旧版接口。

cases.en: Use GitHub to inspect a repository's issues and pull requests through its service connector.
cases.zh: 通过服务连接器查看GitHub仓库的issue和pull request。

cases.en: Search my Notion workspace pages and fetch the relevant page content through its connector.
cases.zh: 通过连接器搜索我的Notion工作区页面，并读取相关页面内容。

cases.en: Find an HR service connector for employee social insurance and benefits administration.
cases.zh: 寻找可以处理员工社保、公积金等人事业务的服务连接器。

limitations: Small human-labelled diagnostic set, not a general task benchmark
Service names in realistic platform-specific requests are intentional; no labels are injected into query text
Targets are relevance labels only and never change ranking
